```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
setwd("/Users/annabelshinichen/Desktop/SchoolWork/MSBMI/Davoli_lab/MSK_survival")

tumors <- c("BLCA","SKCM","LUAD","HNSC","KIRC")

```

```{r}
# ── Survival: align renal code CCRCC -> KIRC ─────────────────────────────────
surv <- read.csv("results_survival.csv") %>%
  mutate(TumorType = recode(OncoTree, CCRCC = "KIRC")) %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband, Event = Comparison,
            Surv_signed = sign_logP_survival)

## ── IS: Table S2 linear regression (coefficient, correct direction) ──────────
is_tbl <- read_excel("TableS2_TCGA_IS_LinRegressions_Tables.xlsx",
                     sheet = "(B) IS_LinReg_CytobandCNV") %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband,
            Event  = str_to_title(cnv_direction),   # cnv_direction = correct dominant direction
            IS_val = Coefficients)

## ── Align cytobands: merge on tumor + cytoband + matched direction ───────────
merged <- inner_join(is_tbl, surv, by = c("TumorType","Cytoband","Event")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IS_val), !is.na(Surv_signed), TumorType %in% tumors) %>%
  mutate(Surv_signed = ifelse(Event == "Gain", -Surv_signed, Surv_signed))  # gain x -1 

# sanity check — cytobands aligned per tumor (should be a few hundred each)
merged %>% count(TumorType, name = "n_aligned") %>% print()
```

```{r}
## ── Per-tumor Spearman + 1,000-permutation  (NO pooling) ─────────────────────
set.seed(42)
per_tumor <- merged %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    if (nrow(d) < 10) return(tibble(n = nrow(d), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    obs  <- cor(d$IS_val, d$Surv_signed, method = "spearman")
    perm <- replicate(1000, cor(d$IS_val, sample(d$Surv_signed), method = "spearman"))
    tibble(n = nrow(d), rho = round(obs, 3), p = mean(abs(perm) >= abs(obs)))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

print(per_tumor)
```

Apply a threshold filter when merging, then re-run 
```{r}
IS_P_THRESHOLD <- 0.05   # keep only cytobands with immune p <= this

## ── IS: Table S2 — carry the immune p-value so we can filter ─────────────────
is_tbl <- read_excel("TableS2_TCGA_IS_LinRegressions_Tables.xlsx",
                     sheet = "(B) IS_LinReg_CytobandCNV") %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband,
            Event  = str_to_title(cnv_direction),
            IS_val = Coefficients,
            IS_p   = P_val)          # use p.adj instead if you want FDR-based cutoff

## ── Align + filter out non-significant immune cytobands ──────────────────────
merged <- inner_join(is_tbl, surv, by = c("TumorType","Cytoband","Event")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IS_val), !is.na(Surv_signed), TumorType %in% tumors) %>%
  filter(IS_p <= IS_P_THRESHOLD)     # <- drops cytobands with weak immune signal

# sanity check — cytobands kept per tumor after filtering
merged %>% count(TumorType, name = "n_after_filter") %>% print()
```



```{r}
# use raw P 
## Survival: raw-p signed (already in the file)
surv <- read.csv("results_survival.csv") %>%
  mutate(TumorType = recode(OncoTree, CCRCC = "KIRC")) %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband, Event = Comparison,
            Surv_signed = sign_logP_survival)          # = -log10(raw P) * sign(log2HR)

## Immune: raw-p signed to match
is_tbl <- read_excel("TableS2_TCGA_IS_LinRegressions_Tables.xlsx",
                     sheet = "(B) IS_LinReg_CytobandCNV") %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband,
            Event = str_to_title(cnv_direction),
            IS_signed = -log10(P_val) * sign(Coefficients))   # raw-p signed

merged <- inner_join(is_tbl, surv, by = c("TumorType","Cytoband","Event")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IS_signed), !is.na(Surv_signed), TumorType %in% tumors) %>%
  mutate(Surv_signed = ifelse(Event == "Gain", -Surv_signed, Surv_signed))  # flip gain

## Scatter per cancer, each dot = a cytoband
ggplot(merged, aes(IS_signed, Surv_signed, color = Event)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = .5) +
  facet_wrap(~TumorType, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "IS  signed -log10(raw p)", y = "Survival  signed -log10(raw p)") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

# Define significance threshold: -log10(0.05) = 1.3
sig_threshold <- -log10(0.05)

merged_labeled <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "1q") & Event == "Gain" &
        abs(Surv_signed) > sig_threshold & abs(IS_signed) > sig_threshold ~ Cytoband,
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "9p") & Event == "Loss" &
        abs(Surv_signed) > sig_threshold & abs(IS_signed) > sig_threshold ~ Cytoband,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    highlight = case_when(
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "1q") & Event == "Gain" ~ "1q Gain",
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "9p") & Event == "Loss" ~ "9p Loss",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot(merged_labeled, aes(IS_signed, Surv_signed, color = Event)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_point(alpha = .3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = .5) +

  # Highlighted points (all 1q gain and 9p loss in SKCM, not just significant)
  geom_point(
    data = merged_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(highlight)),
    aes(fill = highlight),
    shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.4,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +

  # Labels only for significant ones
  geom_label_repel(
    data = merged_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(label)),
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.4, label.padding = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("1q Gain" = "#E8437A", "9p Loss" = "#5BC4E5"),
    name = "Region"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~TumorType, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "IS  signed -log10(raw p)",
    y = "Survival  signed -log10(raw p)",
    color = "Event"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel)
setwd("/Users/annabelshinichen/Desktop/SchoolWork/MSBMI/Davoli_lab/MSK_survival")

tumors <- c("BLCA","SKCM","LUAD","HNSC","KIRC")

# ── shared survival table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
surv <- read.csv("results_survival.csv") %>%
  mutate(TumorType = recode(OncoTree, CCRCC = "KIRC")) %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband, Event = Comparison,
            Surv_signed = sign_logP_survival)   # -log10(raw P) * sign(log2HR)

# ── IS table (coefficients + raw p-value) ─────────────────────────────────────
is_tbl <- read_excel("TableS2_TCGA_IS_LinRegressions_Tables.xlsx",
                     sheet = "(B) IS_LinReg_CytobandCNV") %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband,
            Event     = str_to_title(cnv_direction),
            IS_val    = Coefficients,              # raw coefficient for permutation
            IS_signed = -log10(P_val) * sign(Coefficients),  # signed for scatter
            IS_p      = P_val)                     # for threshold sweep

# ── merged: Ze's fix applied (flip gain survival sign) ───────────────────────
merged <- inner_join(is_tbl, surv, by = c("TumorType","Cytoband","Event")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IS_val), !is.na(Surv_signed), TumorType %in% tumors) %>%
  mutate(Surv_signed = ifelse(Event == "Gain", -Surv_signed, Surv_signed))

merged %>% count(TumorType, Event) %>% print()
```

# set absolute value 
```{r}
## ── permutation helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
perm_cor <- function(d, x, y) {
  obs  <- cor(d[[x]], d[[y]], method = "spearman")
  perm <- replicate(1000, cor(d[[x]], sample(d[[y]]), method = "spearman"))
  tibble(n = nrow(d), rho = round(obs, 3), p = mean(abs(perm) >= abs(obs)))
}

## ── Absolute values, gain + loss combined ────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
abs_res <- merged %>%
  mutate(IS_abs   = abs(IS_val),
         Surv_abs = abs(Surv_signed)) %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    if (nrow(.x) < 10) return(tibble(n = nrow(.x), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    perm_cor(.x, "IS_abs", "Surv_abs")
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

print(abs_res)
write.csv(abs_res, "IS_survival_permutation_ABS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## attach immune p-value to your existing merged
is_p <- read_excel("TableS2_TCGA_IS_LinRegressions_Tables.xlsx",
                   sheet = "(B) IS_LinReg_CytobandCNV") %>%
  transmute(TumorType, Cytoband, Event = str_to_title(cnv_direction), IS_p = P_val)

merged <- merged %>% left_join(is_p, by = c("TumorType","Cytoband","Event"))
```

```{r}
## ── Threshold sweep (filter on immune p) ─────────────────────────────────────
thresholds <- c(1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05)      # 1 = no filter (= your abs_res)

abs_sweep <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(th) {
  set.seed(42)
  merged %>%
    filter(IS_p <= th) %>%
    mutate(IS_abs = abs(IS_val), Surv_abs = abs(Surv_signed)) %>%
    group_by(TumorType) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      if (nrow(.x) < 10) return(tibble(n = nrow(.x), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
      perm_cor(.x, "IS_abs", "Surv_abs")
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, "BH"), threshold = th)
})

## readable grid: rows = tumor, columns = threshold
abs_sweep %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0("rho=", rho, " p=", round(p, 3), " n=", n)) %>%
  select(TumorType, threshold, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = threshold, values_from = cell) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

write.csv(abs_sweep, "IS_survival_permutation_ABS_threshold.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Option 4 pick dominant event 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ── Step 1: load sample metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────────
clin_smp <- read.delim("data_clinical_sample.txt", skip = 4, check.names = FALSE)

# sample → tumor type mapping
sample_tumor <- clin_smp %>%
  transmute(SAMPLE_ID,
            TumorType = recode(ONCOTREE_CODE, CCRCC = "KIRC")) %>%
  filter(TumorType %in% tumors)

# ── Step 2: pivot CNV table to long format ────────────────────────────────────
cnv_raw <- read.delim("all_cnv_table.txt", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "SAMPLE_ID")

cnv_long <- cnv_raw %>%
  inner_join(sample_tumor, by = "SAMPLE_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Arm"), names_to = "ArmCol", values_to = "cnv") %>%
  mutate(Arm = str_remove(ArmCol, "^Arm")) %>%   # "Arm1q" -> "1q"
  filter(!is.na(cnv))

# ── Step 3: dominant event per arm per tumor ──────────────────────────────────
dominant <- cnv_long %>%
  group_by(TumorType, Arm) %>%
  summarise(mean_cnv = mean(cnv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Event = ifelse(mean_cnv > 0, "Gain", "Loss"))

# ── Step 4: extract arm from cytoband in merged ───────────────────────────────
# e.g. "1q24.1" -> "1q", "9p21.3" -> "9p"
merged_dominant <- merged %>%
  mutate(Arm = str_extract(Cytoband, "^[0-9XY]+[pq]")) %>%
  inner_join(dominant %>% select(TumorType, Arm, Event),
             by = c("TumorType", "Arm", "Event"))

merged_dominant %>% count(TumorType, Event) %>% print()

```

```{r}

# ── Step 5: permutation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
dominant_res <- merged_dominant %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    if (nrow(.x) < 10) return(tibble(n = nrow(.x), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    perm_cor(.x, "IS_val", "Surv_signed")
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

print(dominant_res)
write.csv(dominant_res, "IS_survival_permutation_dominant_event.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
merged_dominant_labeled <- merged_dominant %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "1q") & Event == "Gain" ~ Cytoband,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    highlight = case_when(
      TumorType == "SKCM" & str_starts(Cytoband, "1q") & Event == "Gain" ~ "1q Gain",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot(merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(TumorType == "SKCM"),
       aes(IS_signed, Surv_signed, color = Event)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_point(alpha = .3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = .5) +
  geom_point(
    data = merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(highlight), TumorType == "SKCM"),
    aes(fill = highlight), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(label), TumorType == "SKCM"),
    aes(label = label), size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1q Gain" = "#E8437A"), name = "Region") +
  labs(title = "SKCM – IS vs Survival (dominant)",
       x = "IS  signed -log10(raw p)",
       y = "Survival  signed -log10(raw p)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
# print all 1q gain cytobands in SKCM
merged_dominant %>%
  filter(TumorType == "SKCM", str_starts(Cytoband, "1q"), Event == "Gain") %>%
  arrange(IS_signed) %>%
  print()

# print all 9p and 11p loss cytobands in BLCA
merged_dominant %>%
  filter(TumorType == "BLCA", 
         (str_starts(Cytoband, "9p") | str_starts(Cytoband, "11p")), 
         Event == "Loss") %>%
  arrange(IS_signed) %>%
  print()
```


```{r}
merged_dominant_labeled <- merged_dominant %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      TumorType == "BLCA" & str_starts(Cytoband, "11p") & Event == "Loss" ~ Cytoband,
      TumorType == "BLCA" & str_starts(Cytoband, "9p") & Event == "Loss" ~ Cytoband,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    highlight = case_when(
      TumorType == "BLCA" & str_starts(Cytoband, "11p") & Event == "Loss" ~ "11p Loss (BLCA)",
      TumorType == "BLCA" & str_starts(Cytoband, "9p") & Event == "Loss" ~ "9p Loss (BLCA)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot(merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(TumorType == "BLCA"),
       aes(IS_signed, Surv_signed, color = Event)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_point(alpha = .3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = .5) +
  geom_point(
    data = merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(highlight), TumorType == "BLCA"),
    aes(fill = highlight),
    shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.4,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = merged_dominant_labeled %>% filter(!is.na(label), TumorType == "BLCA"),
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.4, label.padding = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("11p Loss (BLCA)" = "#5BC4E5",
               "9p Loss (BLCA)"  = "#5BC4E5"),
    name = "Region"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "BLCA – IS vs Survival (dominant event, gain flipped)",
    x = "IS  signed -log10(raw p)",
    y = "Survival  signed -log10(raw p)",
    color = "Event"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
